title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic Speaking Test 3 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: When you go shopping, do you usually pay for things by cash or by card?
Are you generally careful about how much money you spend?
Have you ever spent money on something you didn't need?
How important is it to you to save money for the future?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe an interesting garden or park you have seen.
cue_card_bullets: where this garden or park is
what you saw in this garden/park
and explain why you think this garden/park is interesting

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are the advantages of having a home with a garden?
How could people living in apartment blocks grow plants and vegetables?
How interested are people in your country in TV shows and magazines about gardens?
Do you think that gardening is a hobby mainly for older people?
What are the benefits for people of gardening as a hobby?
Will gardening be a more popular hobby in the future?
